about: What a material multiplies its texture's coordinates by, as the map's export records it, and whether the export read it: tools/viewer/materials.py profile gives each case's uv (test_materials_and_floors.py), tools/viewer/web/made_mapping.js materialTiling reads it as the case says (shared_cases_test.mjs). A family whose tiling scalar the export reads is known even at 1; a material the export found nothing to read in is not, its 1 only the default.

cases.case: a building material's TileXY, which the export applies
a building material with no TileXY: 1, which the export assumes
a texture coordinate node's tiling, read
a prop's material with nothing read (its expressions cooked away)
a road material's own tiling scalars, which the export doesn't apply
a floor: its family has no tiling scalar the export reads
a coordinate input that isn't a texture coordinate node: not followed
